answer: Trace the funding graph. Every new account needs a small deposit to start, and the ledger records which wallet paid it. Accounts whose deposits flow from one source share a single reward budget, split among them, so spinning up a nebula of clones earns no more than one honest agent. Think of it as a dye test: drop pigment into the source and watch which accounts turn the same color. Writing fifty distinct sonnet-length answers is cheap; hiding where the money came from is not.
